tests.name: strong_exception_array_padding_throw
tests.intent: Verify that when padding an array via a large JSON pointer index throws length_error or out_of_range, the target container remains completely unchanged.

tests.name: strong_exception_nested_object_throw
tests.intent: Verify that when a nested reference token lookup fails and throws inside an intermediate object creation, the root object remains unmodified.

tests.name: json_pointer_dash_append
tests.intent: Verify that appending elements to an array using the dash (-) reference token successfully extends the array.

tests.name: json_pointer_null_conversion_object
tests.intent: Verify that resolving a json_pointer on a null value with object keys converts it into an object and populates it.

tests.name: json_pointer_null_conversion_array
tests.intent: Verify that resolving a json_pointer starting with a valid numeric index on a null value converts it into an array.

tests.name: json_pointer_out_of_range_primitive
tests.intent: Verify that attempting to traverse further down a primitive value via a json_pointer throws out_of_range.

tests.name: json_pointer_array_index_overflow
tests.intent: Verify that an array index exceeding container size limits throws an out_of_range exception.

tests.name: json_pointer_invalid_array_index_leading_zero
tests.intent: Verify that an array index with a leading zero on an existing array throws a parse_error.

tests.name: json_pointer_invalid_array_index_non_numeric
tests.intent: Verify that a non-numeric array index on an existing array throws a parse_error.

tests.name: json_pointer_empty_pointer
tests.intent: Verify that an empty json_pointer returns a reference to the root json value itself.

tests.name: json_pointer_object_search_found
tests.intent: Verify that referencing existing object members via json_pointer successfully retrieves them without modification.

tests.name: json_pointer_const_access
tests.intent: Verify that const operator[](json_pointer) correctly resolves existing paths without modifying or creating anything.

tests.name: json_pointer_escaped_tokens
tests.intent: Verify that json_pointer handles escaped characters like slash (~1) and tilde (~0) correctly.

tests.name: json_pointer_array_padding_valid
tests.intent: Verify that accessing an array index beyond the current size successfully pads the array with nulls up to that index.

tests.name: json_pointer_ordered_json_behavior
tests.intent: Verify that json_pointer works seamlessly with ordered_json maintaining insertion order.

tests.name: json_pointer_deep_nesting_success
tests.intent: Verify creation and access of a deeply nested json pointer path.

tests.name: json_pointer_assignment_overwrite
tests.intent: Verify that assigning a value through a json_pointer to an existing leaf overwrites it properly.

tests.name: json_pointer_mixed_array_object_path
tests.intent: Verify complex alternating paths of objects and arrays via json_pointer.

tests.name: json_pointer_unresolved_middle_token
tests.intent: Verify exception behavior when an intermediate token points to a non-existent object member during read-only or strict checks.

tests.name: json_pointer_split_and_to_string
tests.intent: Verify json_pointer construction from string and round-trip conversion back to string representation.

tests.name: json_pointer_empty_pointer_fixed
tests.intent: Verify that an empty json_pointer returns a reference to the root json value itself.

tests.name: json_pointer_const_access_fixed
tests.intent: Verify that const operator[](json_pointer) correctly resolves existing paths without modifying or creating anything.

tests.name: json_pointer_split_and_to_string_fixed
tests.intent: Verify json_pointer construction from string and round-trip conversion back to string representation.
